# Compatibility fixture

`v1.0.0-full.tape.gz` was created by `tape_backup.py` from the repository
release tag `v1.0.0`, using GNU tar, a 64 KiB buffer, and a 4 MiB simulated
cartridge. It contains `book.txt` with `format-3 compatibility fixture\n`,
an empty directory named `empty`, and a symbolic link `link` to `book.txt`.
It has no appended metadata footer. All contents are synthetic.
